Dear Trailblazers,
The drop rates of the limited 5-star character Himeko • Nova (Erudition: Fire) and the limited 5-star Light Cone A Star That Lights the Night (Erudition) will be boosted for a limited time. The drop rates of the 4-star characters Moze (The Hunt: Lightning), Hanya (Harmony: Physical), and Serval (Erudition: Lightning), as well as the 4-star Light Cones After the Charmony Fall (Erudition), Under the Blue Sky (Destruction), and The Birth of the Self (Erudition) will also be boosted for a limited time. 〓Event Warp Details〓
※ Among the above characters and Light Cones, limited characters and limited Light Cones will not be available in the Stellar Warp event.
※ In this phase of Warp, obtainable 5-star characters include the featured 5-star characters and the custom-selected characters from "Celestial Invitation."
※ During the Event Warp, the limited 5-star character Himeko • Nova (Erudition: Fire) can only be obtained from the "Ad Astra Nova" Character Event Warp, and the limited 5-star characters Cerydra (Harmony: Wind), Anaxa (Erudition: Wind), and Aventurine (Preservation: Imaginary) can only be obtained from the corresponding "Indelible Coterie" Character Event Warps.
※ During the Event Warp, the limited 5-star Light Cone A Star That Lights the Night (Erudition) can only be obtained from the "Brilliant Fixation: A Star That Lights the Night" Light Cone Event Warp. The limited 5-star Light Cones Epoch Etched in Golden Blood (Harmony), Life Should Be Cast to Flames (Erudition), and Inherently Unjust Destiny (Preservation) can only be obtained from the corresponding "Coalesced Truths" Light Cone Event Warps.
※ "Ad Astra Nova" and "Indelible Coterie" are Character Event Warps that share the same guaranteed drop counter. The cumulative Warp count for a guaranteed 5-star character in any Character Event Warp will always be carried over to other Character Event Warps, but is independent of and unaffected by other types of Warps.
※ "Brilliant Fixation" and "Coalesced Truths" are considered Light Cone Event Warps, and share the same guaranteed drop counter. The cumulative Warp count for a guaranteed 5-star Light Cone in any Light Cone Event Warp will always be carried over to other Light Cone Event Warps, but is independent of and unaffected by other types of Warps.
※ The "Indelible Coterie" Character Event Warp and the "Coalesced Truths" Light Cone Event Warp will irregularly become available in future version updates. For more details, please stay tuned for official announcements.
※ The 4-star characters and Light Cones with increased drop rates in Phase 1 and Phase 2 of Version 4.4's Warp events will remain unchanged.
※ For more information, please head to the Warp screen.

Complete the challenges to obtain Stellar Jades, Adventure Logs, Universal Enhancement Materials, and credits.

events.title: "Imagenae: Holy Grail War" Event Details
events.description:
〓"Imagenae: Holy Grail War" Event Details〓
A golden rain falls. A Holy Grail, stolen. Somewhere in the shadows beyond the Phantasmoon's reach, a certain king's treasury has unexpectedly shattered into shambles. To prevent chaos, you'll have no choice but to team up with Rin Tohsaka, a mage from another world, to restore order, and while you're at it, to claim your own share of the treasure.
※ This collaboration event "Fate/Star Rail Night" will unfold as the story progresses.
〓Limited-Time Event Period〓
2026/07/24 12:00:00 - 2026/08/26 03:59:00
※ After the limited-time event concludes, Fate/Star Rail Night will be moved to Conventional Memoir, where Trailblazers can continue to experience the Trailblaze Continuance and its gameplay.
〓Participation Requirements〓
Trailblaze Level ≥ 3
※ Trailblaze Continuance "Imagenae: Holy Grail War" can be experienced in advance through the Finality's Vision function.
※ It is recommended that Trailblazers complete the Trailblaze Mission "Planarcadia — So Laughed the Masses" before experiencing this content.
〓Event Rewards〓
Limited-Time Rewards
Permanent Rewards
〓Event Details:〓
● In "Fate/Star Rail Night", the Trailblazer will participate in the Imagenae Holy Grail War, teaming up with Rin Tohsaka to collect scattered Treasures and use Conceptual Mystic Codes in combat.
● The Trailblaze Continuance includes storylines such as "The Opening Battle," "Muscle Magic," and "West Wind Blossom." As the story progresses, more usable Servants and "Conceptual Mystic Code" cards will be unlocked.
● In combat, several Conceptual Mystic Code cards will be drawn each turn. Select a card to view its specific effects. Drag a card to play it and trigger the Conceptual Mystic Code effect.
● Used Conceptual Mystic Code cards will go to the Discard Pile. When the Draw Pile is empty, the cards in the Discard Pile will be shuffled back into the Draw Pile.
● Using Conceptual Mystic Code cards consumes corresponding magical energy. If you do not have enough magical energy or run out of cards in your hand, you can select End Turn.
● Defeating enemies or using Conceptual Mystic Code cards will charge the corresponding Master or Servant. Once Energy is full, you can use an Ultimate with special effects.
● The ally squad has a set amount of Team HP. Defeat all enemies before Team HP reaches zero to win.
● Complete the Trailblaze Continuance "After Daybreak" to unlock Infinite Trial. You can use collected Conceptual Mystic Codes to continue taking on higher-difficulty challenges.
〓Notes〓
● After the "Fate/Star Rail Night" limited-time event ends, Trailblazers will no longer be able to obtain the limited-time rewards offered during the event, but they can still visit the Dovebrook District to experience the event and obtain permanent rewards.
〓"Fate Contract: Renewal" Event Details〓
The wheel of fate turns endlessly, and our paths converge today. Will you renew an ancient oath, or seal a brand-new pact? Command your Servant, and fight as one.
〓Event Period〓
2026/07/24 12:00:00 — Before Version 4.6 ends
〓Participation Requirements〓
Trailblaze Level ≥ 3
〓Event Details:〓
● During the event, Trailblazers can log in to the game to claim the limited 5-star collaboration character Gilgamesh (Destruction: Lightning) ×1 or Archer (The Hunt: Quantum) ×1 and materials to build him to Lv. 60.
〓"Fate Gift" Event Details〓
〓Event Period〓
During Version 4.4
〓Participation Requirements〓
Unlock Warp
〓Event Details:〓
● During the event, Trailblazers who spend 200 Star Rail Special Passes in any Version 4.4 Warp event can select and claim 1 limited 5-Star Light Cone from I Am As You Behold (Destruction) and The Hell Where Ideals Burn (The Hunt) after the new Version 4.4 Collaboration Warp begins at 2026/07/24 12:00:00.
● All Warp events in Version 4.4 share the accumulated total of Star Rail Special Pass uses.
● Trailblazers who meet the event conditions but do not claim their rewards in time will be able to select and claim 1 of the limited 5-Star Light Cones I Am As You Behold (Destruction) or The Hell Where Ideals Burn (The Hunt) via in-game mail after the event ends. The mail will be valid for 30 days.

events.title: "Antigraft Brickbuster": Complete hacking operations to obtain Self-Modeling Resins, Tracks of Destiny, Stellar Jades, and more!
events.description:
No corner stays dust-free forever. At Aventurine's request, you launched an investigation into IPC corruption by hacking into their database.
〓Limited-Time Event Period〓
After the Version 4.4 update - 2026/08/26 03:59:00
※ After the limited-time event concludes, Antigraft Brickbuster will be moved to Conventional Memoir, where Trailblazers can continue to experience its gameplay.
〓Participation Requirement〓
Trailblaze Level ≥ 21
※ This content can be experienced in advance through the Finality's Vision function.
※ It is recommended that Trailblazers complete the Trailblaze Missions "Penacony — Stranger in a Strange Land" and "Planarcadia — Real Holy Laughter!" before experiencing this content.
〓Event Rewards〓
〓Limited-Time Rewards〓
〓Permanent Rewards〓
〓Event Details〓
● This event is divided into Story Mode and Multiplayer Mode.
● In Story Mode, the Trailblazer will carry out a hack with the assistance of Silver Wolf and Prometheus. Place the extracted data blocks, counter the firewall's ability mechanics, and complete the hack as smoothly as possible.
● Story Mode contains a total of 7 stages. Successfully completing a stage unlocks the next one. During the challenge, Trailblazers can obtain powerful abilities to tackle higher-difficulty challenges.
● Multiplayer Mode will unlock after completing the Story Mode. Trailblazers can choose to team up with other cyber hackers to take on higher-difficulty challenges, or continue partnering with Silver Wolf and Prometheus.
〓Note〓
● After the Antigraft Brickbuster limited-time event ends, Trailblazers will no longer be able to obtain the limited-time rewards during the event period, but they can still visit the Radiant Feldspar map to speak with Prometheus, experience the event, and obtain permanent rewards.

events.title: "Currency Wars: Zero-Sum Game" Season Expansion Details V4.4
events.description:
After the Version 4.4 update, "Currency Wars: Zero-Sum Game" welcomes a season expansion!
Mortenax Blade and Himeko • Nova will come on board as new employees, entering Currency Wars immediately after the version update. Collaboration characters Rin Tohsaka and Gilgamesh will also officially join Currency Wars following the collaboration event update! Additionally, the Holy Grail of Destiny Bond has been added, delivering a brand-new match experience!
Sampo, Blade, Pela, and Himeko will become "Expert Advisors" and feature exclusive gameplay.
In this expansion, the Ascension Level Cap will be increased to Level 170. New content has been added to Expected Profit and Bond Links, from which Trailblazers can obtain even more rewards. The highest Rank difficulty will also be increased to A8 Wealth Creator 50.
Additionally, the Strategic Investment Department has strengthened a huge number of Bonds and characters, while also optimizing and adjusting some characters' Bonds, costs, positioning, and abilities. We hope Trailblazers can experience more lineups and gameplay possibilities. At the same time, a massive amount of content, including Investment Environments, Investment Strategies, and opponent factions, has been added to enrich the match environment.
Let's check out the full update details!
〓Update Time〓
After the Version 4.4 update
〓Reward Preview〓
〓Expansion Content Overview〓
● Adds four new characters: Mortenax Blade, Himeko • Nova, Rin Tohsaka, and Gilgamesh. Mortenax Blade and Himeko • Nova will immediately join Currency Wars after the version update. Rin Tohsaka and Gilgamesh will also officially join Currency Wars following the collaboration event update!
● Adds the Holy Grail of Destiny Bond, providing a brand-new gameplay experience.
● Sampo, Blade, Pela, and Himeko will become "Expert Advisors" and have their own exclusive gameplay.
● Enhances and adjusts a huge number of characters, Bonds, and more, allowing Trailblazers to explore even more team lineups and gameplay strategies.
● Ascension Level Cap expanded to Level 170. Increasing your Ascension Level grants rewards such as Self-Modeling Resin, Stellar Jades, and more.
● New content has been added to Expected Profit and Bond Links. Complete them to obtain rewards such as Stellar Jades, Relic Remains, and Traveler's Guides.
● Adds massive amounts of gameplay content including Investment Environments, Investment Strategies, Opponents, Enemy Affixes, and more.
● Max rank difficulty increased to A8 Wealth Creator 50.
〓New Characters〓
■ Mortenax Blade (Nihility: Fire)
● Cost: 2-cost
● Bonds: Stellaron Hunters, Bloodflame, Debuff
Off-field: Before entering combat, Mortenax Blade will forge a piece of temporary advanced equipment tailored to this unit. If Mortenax Blade is already equipped with 3 pieces of equipment, he will temporarily upgrade 1 of them at random into privileged equipment.
At the start of combat, Mortenax Blade will use his Ultimate to deploy a Zone, weakening enemies and buffing allies. When taking action, Mortenax Blade consumes HP to attack enemies, and using his Ultimate can restore HP. Additionally, when on-field teammates attack, Mortenax Blade can gain Charge to use an extra Skill.
■ Himeko • Nova (Erudition: Fire)
● Cost: 3-cost
● Bonds: Express Cohort, Navigator (Independent Bond)
● Character Empowerment:
On-field: Gains more Base On-Field Strength upon star-up, and "Trailblaze Companions" members can also use "Assist Skill" while off-field.
● Navigator (Independent Bond):
You can select other characters from the "Express Cohort" Bond to enhance.
After selecting a character, Himeko • Nova gains the following buffs:
Himeko • Nova will directly join the selected character's school Bond, obtain the corresponding Bond effect, and increase the Bond tally by 1.
Obtain the equipment effect of the selected character's first piece of equipment.
Depending on the chosen character, the "Astral Express" summoned by "Express Cohort" will vary, and Himeko • Nova's abilities will gain different enhancement effects. Additionally, the "Light Rail" provided upon impact by the "Astral Express" will also produce different additional effects based on the selected character.
■ Rin Tohsaka (Erudition: Quantum)
● Cost: 1-cost
● Bonds: Skill Points, Holy Grail of Destiny
● Character Empowerment:
On-field: After obtaining a certain amount of "Gem Energy," a Joint Follow-Up ATK with Archer can be launched regardless of whether Archer is on the field. After using the Enhanced Skill, "Gem Energy" will be consumed to increase the ally squad's CRIT DMG.
Off-field: When Skill Points change, gains "Gem Energy" and can launch a Joint ATK. When taking action, consumes all "Gem Energy" to attack enemies and provide CRIT DMG to allies.
※ After the Version 4.4 update – 2026/07/24 12:00:00 before the collaboration content goes live, Rin Tohsaka will appear in the store in her "Projection" form. Rin Tohsaka in the "Projection" state possesses this unit's Bonds and "Projection" state effects. In the "Projection" state, star-up is unavailable, and the character model and ability effects will not be displayed.
■ Gilgamesh (Destruction: Lightning)
● Cost: 2-cost
● Bonds: Energy, Holy Grail of Destiny
● Character Empowerment:
On-field: Increases all allies' Lucky Strike DMG based on the squad's equipment count. Gilgamesh himself gains an even greater bonus.
Off-field: Enters an enhanced state based on squad actions, using Skill and Ultimate to attack all enemies. Increases Lucky Strike DMG for all allies based on the squad's equipment count. Gilgamesh himself gains double this bonus.
※ After the Version 4.4 update – 2026/07/24 12:00:00 before the collaboration content goes live, Gilgamesh will appear in the Store in "Projection" form. In the "Projection" state, Gilgamesh possesses this unit's Bonds and "Projection" state effects. While in the "Projection" state, star up is unavailable, and the character model and ability effects will not be displayed.
〓New Bond〓
■ School Bond: Holy Grail of Destiny
● Bond Levels: 2/3/4/5
● Bond Members: Rin Tohsaka, Gilgamesh, Saber, Archer
● Bond Effect:
The Bond Level provides On/Off-Field Strength to characters within the Bond.
Additionally, when your Bond level increases, you can perform one "Holy Grail Wish." The Holy Grail will randomly issue two wish missions. Complete either one of your choice to obtain the corresponding wish mission reward.
Mission difficulty and rewards both scale with your Bond level. Complete missions for a chance to score "Destiny Components" such as "Avalon" and "Enuma Elish." Equip them to unlock powerful bonus effects! You might also snag rewards like Gold Coins, Emblems, various items, or even recruit Archer directly in the early stages!
● Enhanced Character: Saber
Saber: Increased the character's base DMG.
※ Following the Version 4.4 update and prior to the collaboration content going live at 2026/07/24 12:00:00, the Holy Grail's magical energy will not yet be fully replenished, and thus wish missions will not be issued. During this phase, the "Holy Grail of Destiny" Bond will provide temporary buffs to the entire team based on the Bond level.
〓Expert Advisors〓
● After the Version 4.4 update, Sampo, Blade, Pela, and Himeko will become "Expert Advisors" and feature exclusive gameplay.
〓Character & Bond Adjustments〓
■ DoT
● New Bond member added: Jiaoqiu (1-Cost)
● Became an Expert Advisor: Sampo.
● Increased the DMG Amplification provided by the Bond effect. Increased the DoT multiplier applied to the enemy when "Super Excitation" is triggered. Increased the trigger count of "Super Excitation" at Bond Level 6.
● Since Jiaoqiu will be joining the "DoT" Bond, he will leave the "Heal" Bond.
● Enhanced Character: Jiaoqiu
Jiaoqiu: Jiaoqiu can immediately use his Ultimate at the start of combat. His Ultimate also increases the DoT taken by enemies.

● New Bond member added: Mortenax Blade (2-Cost)

events.title: Fate[UBW] Collaboration Warp Details
events.description:
Dear Trailblazers,
Characters Rin Tohsaka and Gilgamesh, as well as Light Cones Flickering Stars and I Am As You Behold, will be added to the Fate[UBW] Collaboration Warp, and will be available long-term after 2026/07/24 12:00:00.
The Fate[UBW] Collaboration Warp includes the following:
〓"The Gem Coursing in Red" Character Collaboration Warp〓
● During the "The Gem Coursing in Red" Character Collaboration Warp period, the drop rate of the limited 5-star collaboration character Rin Tohsaka (Erudition: Quantum) will be boosted.
〓"Kaleidic Coruscation" Light Cone Collaboration Warp〓
● During the "Kaleidic Coruscation" Collaboration Light Cone Warp period, the drop rate of the limited 5-star collaboration Light Cone Flickering Stars (Erudition) will be boosted.
〓"Of the Beginning, Enuma Elish" Character Collaboration Warp〓
● During the "Of the Beginning, Enuma Elish" Character Collaboration Warp period, the drop rate of the limited 5-star collaboration character Gilgamesh (Destruction: Lightning) will be boosted.
〓"Age of Gods Golden Gate" Light Cone Collaboration Warp〓
● During the "Age of Gods Golden Gate" Light Cone Collaboration Warp period, the drop rate of the limited 5-star collaboration Light Cone I Am As You Behold (Destruction) will be boosted.
〓"Excalibur Excelsior" Character Collaboration Warp〓
● During the "Excalibur Excelsior" Character Collaboration Warp period, the drop rate of the limited 5-star collaboration character Saber (Destruction: Wind) will be boosted.
〓"Birth of a King" Light Cone Collaboration Warp〓
● During the "Birth of a King" Light Cone Collaboration Warp period, the drop rate of the limited 5-star collaboration Light Cone A Thankless Coronation (Destruction) will be boosted.
〓"I Am the Bone of My Sword" Character Collaboration Warp〓
● During the "I Am the Bone of My Sword" Character Collaboration Warp period, the drop rate of the limited 5-star collaboration character Archer (The Hunt: Quantum) will be boosted.
〓"Red Radiance of Fuyuki" Light Cone Collaboration Warp〓
● During the "Red Radiance of Fuyuki" Light Cone Collaboration Warp period, the drop rate of the limited 5-star collaboration Light Cone The Hell Where Ideals Burn (The Hunt) will be boosted.
※ Characters Rin Tohsaka, Gilgamesh, Saber, and Archer, as well as Light Cones Flickering Stars, I Am As You Behold, A Thankless Coronation, and The Hell Where Ideals Burn all belong to the Fate[UBW] Collaboration Warp. Please see below for details regarding the guarantee rules.
〓Fate[UBW] Collaboration Warp Details〓
※ "The Gem Coursing in Red," "Of the Beginning, Enuma Elish," and the currently available "Excalibur Excelsior" and "I Am the Bone of My Sword" Warps are all considered Fate[UBW] Character Collaboration Warps, and share the same guaranteed drop counter. The cumulative Warp count for a guaranteed 5-star character in any Fate[UBW] Character Collaboration Warp will always be carried over to other Fate[UBW] Character Collaboration Warps, but is independent of and unaffected by other types of Warps.
※ The "Kaleidic Coruscation" and "Age of Gods Golden Gate" Warps, as well as the currently available "Birth of a King" and "Red Radiance of Fuyuki" Warps, are all considered Fate[UBW] Light Cone Collaboration Warps, and share the same guaranteed drop counter. The cumulative Warp count for a guaranteed 5-star Light Cone in any Fate[UBW] Light Cone Collaboration Warp will always be carried over to other Fate[UBW] Light Cone Collaboration Warps, but is independent of and unaffected by other types of Warps.
※ During the Collaboration Warp period, the limited 5-star collaboration character Rin Tohsaka (Erudition: Quantum) can only be obtained from the "The Gem Coursing in Red" Character Collaboration Warp, and the limited 5-star collaboration character Gilgamesh (Destruction: Lightning) can only be obtained from the "Of the Beginning, Enuma Elish" Character Collaboration Warp. The limited 5-star collaboration character Saber (Destruction: Wind) can only be obtained from the "Excalibur Excelsior" Character Collaboration Warp, and the limited 5-star collaboration character Archer (The Hunt: Quantum) can only be obtained from the "I Am the Bone of My Sword" Character Collaboration Warp.
※ During the Collaboration Warp period, the limited 5-star collaboration Light Cone Flickering Stars (Erudition) can only be obtained from the "Kaleidic Coruscation" Light Cone Collaboration Warp, and the limited 5-star collaboration Light Cone I Am As You Behold (Destruction) can only be obtained from the "Age of Gods Golden Gate" Light Cone Collaboration Warp. The limited 5-star collaboration Light Cone A Thankless Coronation (Destruction) can only be obtained from the "Birth of a King" Light Cone Collaboration Warp, and the limited 5-star collaboration Light Cone The Hell Where Ideals Burn (The Hunt) can only be obtained from the "Red Radiance of Fuyuki" Light Cone Collaboration Warp.
※ In the Fate[UBW] Character Collaboration Warp, obtainable 5-star characters include the featured 5-star characters and the custom-selected characters from "Celestial Invitation."
※ In the Fate[UBW] Character Collaboration Warp, there are no featured 4-star rate-up characters. The drop rates for all 4-star characters are equal.
※ In the Fate[UBW] Light Cone Collaboration Warp, there are no featured 4-star rate-up Light Cones. The drop rates for all 4-star Light Cones are equal.
※ The Fate[UBW] Collaboration Warp will be available for a long time, with no scheduled end date.
※ For more details, please head to the Warp screen.
※ Should any of the above details change, a prior notice will be issued.
※ Special Note on Collaboration Character English Voiceovers: The collaboration characters have no English voiceovers. Without changing your audio language in Settings, you may individually switch each collaboration character's interaction, combat, and idle voice lines to the Fate[UBW] Original Licensed Voice (Japanese) via Character Details Profile Voice.
〓Character Trial Event: Along With Heroic Spirits Update〓
● Requirement: Unlock Travel Log
● Event Period: Updates after 2026/07/24 12:00:00
● Event Details: Trial stages for the new characters Rin Tohsaka (Erudition: Quantum) and Gilgamesh (Destruction: Lightning) have been added. Upon completing the challenges, Trailblazers can obtain Stellar Jades, Adventure Logs, Universal Enhancement Materials, and credits.
〓Celestial Invitation Custom Characters〓
Trailblazers can customize 7 "Celestial Invitation" characters in the Fate[UBW] Character Collaboration Warp.
※ The first time you obtain a 5-star character in this Warp event, there is a 50% chance that it will be one of the featured 5-star characters. There is also a 50% chance that it will be any of the obtainable 5-star characters in this Warp phase, with equal chance among them.
※ The selectable character catalog of "Celestial Invitation" in the "Fate[UBW] Character Collaboration Warp" will remain identical to that in the "Character Event Warp" and will be updated simultaneously.
※ Regardless of whether you trigger the featured guarantee, it will be reset when you obtain the featured character.
〓5-Star Character Eidolon Surplus Special Note〓
● When Trailblazers obtain a 5-star character's Eidolon (including limited collaboration characters) that has already reached max Eidolons, they will additionally receive Silver Companion Spirit ×1.
● The optimization for 5-star character Eidolon surplus applies to all sources and methods of obtaining 5-star characters.

events.title: "Divergent Universe: Arcadian Chronicles": Massive Update to New Divergent Universe Subject
events.description:
The Phantasmoon is full once more, and countless acts of "Elation" are staging themselves in every corner of the universe. And the subject of extrapolation this time is none other than these games, one after another...
〓Update Time〓
After the Version 4.1 update
〓Participation Requirements〓
Clear Simulated Universe: World 3
※ This content can be experienced in advance through the Finality's Vision function.
〓Divergent Universe: Arcadian Chronicles Rewards Preview〓
〓Update Notes〓
A new subject in the Divergent Universe is now available! Not only does it feature the brand-new "Mask" gameplay and a new way to select Domains, but it also includes massive updates to Blessings, Equations, Weighted Curios, and random Occurrences!
■ Supplicant's Mask
● The new "Supplicant's Mask" gameplay mode is now available! Select a mask before each run to decide your play style.
● Different masks possess different "Mask Effects," providing various buffs during combat.
● Different masks can obtain "Wishpower" in various ways to level up. After leveling up, you can select a "miracle" that either enhances "Mask Effects" or provides various buffs.
● "Highlights" will appear during combat. When "Highlights" Charge reaches 100%, it will enhance the character and cause them to immediately take action. Mask Level Ups will further enhance the effects of "Highlights."
■ Domains & Beacons
● The brand-new "Deck" system combines with the "Supplicant's Mask" effects to make Domain Selection more strategic than ever!
● At the start of every extrapolation, you will obtain a deck which includes the Domains you may encounter during this run.
● Before entering each Domain, the Trailblazer will draw several Domains from the deck's Draw Pile, and select the Domain to proceed to.
● The Domain drawn this time will enter the discard pile. After the draw pile is depleted, Domains in the discard pile will return to the draw pile after a Shuffle.
● Domains can be leveled up. After leveling up a Domain, its contents will be enhanced.
● Most Domains can have "beacons" attached to them, granting the Domain various bonus effects.
● Mask effects and "miracles" obtained from Level Ups will also bring various effects to your deck and Domains.
■ Moonlit Tales
● Completing the extrapolation will grant the "Cartridge" item, used to activate "Moonlit Tales."
● Activate "Moonlit Tales" to obtain various buffs. You can also unlock and view Secrets.
■ Character Trial & Enhancement Effects
● Trial characters will be available in the Divergent Universe. You will be able to try out all characters released from two versions ago or earlier.
● In the Divergent Universe, all characters will receive different buffs.
〓Special Notice〓
● After this update, the Divergent Universe: Protean Hero rewards will be reset. The reset contents include:
"Gallery of Possibilities" Rewards and Collection Progress
"Stable Computing Array" Rewards
"Synchronicity Level" Rewards & Levels
Ordinary Extrapolation First-Time Clearance Rewards
"Divergent Universe: Protean Hero" - Related Tutorials Entries
※ "Threshold Protocol" progress and the "Divergent Universe: Protean Hero" title will be carried over based on specific rules.
※ Activated Nodes and claimed "Inspiration" in the "Inspiration Circuit" will not be reset.
※ After the countdown ends, all Operational Records of Divergent Universe: Protean Hero will be unlocked.
Don't forget to claim your rewards in time, Trailblazer~

After unlocking Nameless Glory, you will immediately obtain Stellar Jade ×680.
